mapper.insert: insert into dish_template_change_requests (merchant_id,template_id,base_template_version,base_snapshot_json,snapshot_json,submit_note,status,submitted_by) values (#{merchantId},#{templateId},#{baseTemplateVersion},cast(#{baseSnapshotJson} as json), cast(#{snapshotJson} as json),#{submitNote},'PENDING',#{submittedBy})
mapper.select: select count(*) from dish_template_change_requests where merchant_id=#{merchantId} and template_id=#{templateId} and status='PENDING'
select from dish_template_change_requests r left join merchants m on m.id=r.merchant_id left join dish_templates t on t.id=r.template_id where r.id=#{requestId} for update

select from dish_template_change_requests r left join merchants m on m.id=r.merchant_id left join dish_templates t on t.id=r.template_id where r.id=#{requestId} and r.merchant_id=#{merchantId} for update
select count(*) from dish_template_change_requests r left join dish_templates t on t.id=r.template_id where 1=1

select from dish_template_change_requests r left join merchants m on m.id=r.merchant_id left join dish_templates t on t.id=r.template_id where 1=1 order by r.submitted_at desc,r.id desc limit #{offset},#{pageSize}
mapper.update: update dish_template_change_requests set status='WITHDRAWN',withdrawn_by=#{withdrawnBy},withdrawn_at=current_timestamp(6) where id=#{requestId} and status='PENDING'
update dish_template_change_requests set status='APPROVED',reviewed_by=#{reviewedBy},review_reason=#{reason}, reviewed_at=current_timestamp(6) where id=#{requestId} and status='PENDING'
update dish_template_change_requests set status='REJECTED',reviewed_by=#{reviewedBy},review_reason=#{reason}, reviewed_at=current_timestamp(6) where id=#{requestId} and status='PENDING'
update dish_template_change_requests set result_notification_id=#{notificationId} where id=#{requestId}
